body: Pushed again, for fixing clang-format issue

That validation doesn't seem valid. A folder may exist for multiple reasons, the most common one being that you just changed the path, which case you won't be able to run the project until restart. or opening the folder from Project menu.

Also the original issue had problems specifically with overrides, which this PR does not check. If you set `application/config/custom_user_dir_name.web`, you will have potentially broken Web export, but the safeguard won't tell you that.

I just discovered that this only handles the case when starting the project normally (F5).
When running current scene (F6), the path is not validated. Interestingly, the project will crash on startup when folder is invalid (not caused by this PR). Can be easily tested by putting a Windows reserved name as data directory, e.g. CON.

Looks like the same issue as #103367. I couldn't reproduce it with the original example, but with the reserved name on Windows it results in a crash.

The fix you did should be probably moved deeper (in EditorRunBar I think?), so that it handles any form of running. Aside from project and current scene, you can run a custom scene or run from a plugin.
